items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 23 at 8:29AM EDT until September 25 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 30 mph with gusts up to 40 to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...East Carteret and Mainland Dare Counties, and Hatteras
Island, Northern Outer Banks, and Ocracoke Island.

* WHEN...From 2 PM this afternoon to 2 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 23 at 4:48AM EDT until September 23 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, dangerous rip currents
and strong longshore currents in the surf zone. For the
Coastal Flood Warning, 2 to 4 feet of inundation above ground
level expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways. Up to 1 foot of inundation is possible for sound-
side flooding when winds become more northerly late Thursday
and Friday.

* WHERE...Ocracoke Island.

* WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, from 8 AM EDT this
morning through this evening. For the Coastal Flood Warning,
from 2 PM this afternoon to 11 PM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Portions of Highway 12
will be inundated. Low lying property including homes,
businesses, and some critical infrastructure will be
inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur. Rip currents can
sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into deeper
water. Strong longshore currents will create dangerous
swimming conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Prolonged nature of the event will
continue to erode dune structures. Winds and waves are
forecast to peak latter half of Thursday.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued September 23 at 3:06AM EDT until September 25 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 12 to 17 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal and offshore waters from Cape Hatteras to
Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...From 2 PM this afternoon to 8 PM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
